levers.label: Azure CSP Reservation & Savings Plan (incl. PTUs)
Growth Accelerator – Tier 2 (Foundry, GitHub, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Copilot Studio)

rules: Growth = year-over-year increase in monthly ACR at customer-tenant level; the baseline is the tenant's whole prior-year ACR regardless of workload, partner or licensing motion.
Incremental ACR is attributed to workloads by service classification and paid at that tier's growth rate.
EA → CSP transitions: declines in legacy revenue on the same tenant offset CSP growth.
Revenue simply moved from another channel is classified 'Shift' and does not earn growth.
Paid monthly, 45 days after the earning period. Azure credit offer (ACO)-influenced ACR is not eligible.

cocp.title: Change of Channel Partner (COCP) — CSP
rules: COCP is identified when the change replaces the entire incumbent CSP partner set for a customer tenant and solution area (Azure, M365, D365), whether CSP→CSP or EA→CSP.
Partners flagged under COCP do not earn Core Rate or Strategic Accelerator incentives for 12 months from detection.
Not COCP if at least one existing CSP partner (including the distributor or indirect reseller, from 1 Aug 2026) stays associated with the customer.
A subscription that expires and is recreated with a different CSP partner on the same tenant and solution area is treated as COCP.
EA → CSP: COCP applies only when EA MRR declines significantly AND a new CSP partner is introduced; it applies to the new partner only.
Exceptions (support ticket): CSP authorisation-type changes, partner mergers / acquisitions / splits, business closure, partner off-boarding.
